_doc_architecture: Selects the git workflow preset. Each preset ships sensible defaults for all branch-role fields below. Individual overrides always win over the preset. Supported: 'feature-based' (default), 'gitflow', 'github-flow', 'gitlab-flow', 'trunk-based', 'monorepo'.
_doc_branch_names: All branch name fields are OPTIONAL — unset fields inherit from the chosen architecture preset, which falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG. Only set fields that differ from the preset.
_doc_mainBranch: Canonical production branch. Used as the hotfix base in gitflow. Default: 'main'.
_doc_developBranch: Integration branch for in-progress work. gitflow: 'develop'. github-flow / gitlab-flow / trunk: same as mainBranch. Default: 'develop'.
_doc_rootBranch: Common/shared-source integration branch (feature-based only). git-extract-common opens MRs into this branch. git-sync-from-root merges this into your feature branch. Default: 'root'.
_doc_devBranch: Dev-build integration branch (feature-based only). Feature branches open MRs here to trigger dev environment CI builds. Default: 'dev'.
_doc_stagingBranch: Staging environment branch (gitlab-flow only). Code promotes from mainBranch to stagingBranch via MR. Default: 'staging'.
_doc_productionBranch: Production environment branch (gitlab-flow only). Code promotes from stagingBranch here via MR. Default: 'production'.
_doc_branch_prefixes: Used by git-start-branch and git-finish-branch to construct branch names and infer branch type when finishing.
_doc_commonBranchPrefix: Prefix for auto-generated common branches (feature-based). 'common' → 'common/feature-auth-20260526'. Default: 'common'.
_doc_mrBranchPrefix: Prefix for safe MR branches created by git-create-mr --checkout. 'mr' → 'mr/feature-auth-20260526120000'. Default: 'mr'.
_doc_feature_based_section: The following fields are only meaningful when architecture = 'feature-based'.
_doc_featurePath: Path(s) treated as feature-specific source code. Anything OUTSIDE these paths is considered common/shared code and will be extracted by git-extract-common. Accepts a string or an array of strings.
_doc_commonExcludePaths: Directories excluded from the common-extract diff entirely. Use for: submodules, vendored packages, generated directories. Each entry excludes the directory root AND all its nested files.
_doc_commonExcludeFiles: Individual files excluded from the common-extract diff. Use for: build artifacts, version files, local-only config. Each entry excludes exactly one file (not its parent directory).
_doc_shared_section: The following fields apply to all architectures.
_doc_remote: Git remote name. Change if your remote is not named 'origin'. Default: 'origin'.
_doc_protectedBranches: Branches the CLI refuses to use as a source/feature branch. Prevents accidental destructive operations on integration branches.
_doc_mergeRequestProvider: MR/PR provider used by all commands that open merge requests. 'gitlab' → glab CLI. 'github' → gh CLI. 'none' → prints browser URL only. Default: 'gitlab'.
_doc_syncStrategy: Sync strategy used by git-sync-from-root. 'merge' creates a merge commit (safer, preserves history context). 'rebase' replays your commits on top of root (linear history, requires force-push). Default: 'merge'.
